# Maths for Data Science - semester control repo

This is the **`.github` repo** for the `hertie-maths-data-science-f2026` semester org. **Students and instructors rarely need to touch anything in this repo directly.**

_Instructors (TAs and faculty assistants included): nothing to run from here - every operation is in the Instructor Console, or `python -m dsl_course` from a laptop, against the parent **course org**._

Built and kept in sync by the [DSL teaching toolkit](https://github.com/hertie-data-science-lab/dsl-teaching-toolkit).
